title: Trouble from within
explanation: The source gloss points to a breach of trust from someone relied upon. The damage comes from within the thing meant to work properly.
meaning_odia: ଯାହାକୁ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରାଯାଇଥାଏ, ସେହି ଲୋକ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଭାଙ୍ଗିବାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି।
usage_example: A trusted organiser secretly undermines the group’s plan. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
